chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 544: Li Huowang Breaks the Deadlock with a Heart-Element Trade
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang turns a life-or-death standoff into a high-stakes negotiation, offering a Heart-Element for the Taixu Sword while learning Four Qi has fallen—and the bad omens keep piling up.
og_title: Breaking the Deadlock – A Heart-Element for a Sword
og_description: Li Huowang drinks, schemes, and trades human essence to escape a no-win situation in the Supervisory Heavenly Office.
twitter_title: Li Huowang just offered a whole Heart-Element as a trade good. Office politics in the Dao-Twisted World is wild.
twitter_description: Li Huowang turns a cornered standoff into a drinking session and a terrifying lore drop about the fall of Four Qi.

lore_anchors.definition: A spiritually potent being refined into a weapon or artifact; the Taixu Sword is made from one, making it priceless and dangerous.
A rare human constitution that can be traded as a living cultivation ingredient; Li Huowang offers one as a bargaining chip.
The Office’s most sacred rule forbids members from entangling with the imperial court to avoid becoming kingmakers.
A small neighboring state that has suddenly fallen; its new dynasty has abolished the Supervisory Heavenly Office, a very bad omen
